events.name: The Bikini Bottoms
events.description:
Somebody call the Krusty Krab, because Azúcar just got absorbent, yellow, and porous — and honestly, so are we. The Bikini Bottoms drops you straight into the deep end: SpongeBob characters strutting the runway, decor that screams pineapple-under-the-sea, and a soundtrack where Latinx beats collide head-on with your favorite Nickelodeon nostalgia. Tahboo hosts this one like the true krabby patty secret formula they are — equal parts chaos, glam, and pure camp.

Expect Squidward realness, Sandy Cheeks fierceness, maybe a Plankton villain arc or two — this Main Floor is transforming into the wildest corner of the ocean you've ever seen. The mixes are spiced, the characters are unhinged, and the drag is next level.

Dress code: full send. Come dressed as your favorite Bikini Bottom resident — best SpongeBob look of the night takes home a prize, so raid the closet and commit. This is not a night for the goofy goobers who stay home. October 22, 9PM, Main Floor — F.U.N. starts the second you walk in.

events.name: American horror story watch party

Expect low lights, moody cocktails, and couches turned into front-row seats. This isn't a quiet watch — it's commentary, gasps, and maybe a drink spilled when things get gory. Ale keeps the energy sharp between episodes, so the transition from finale to premiere feels like its own plot twist.

Come early to claim your spot — the Lounge fills fast when horror and Latinx nightlife collide. Dark drinks, darker storylines, and a crowd that's here for every twisted detail. Entrance is free, the thrills are not optional.

events.name: Scream Queens Drag Show
events.description:
The fog hits first — curling low across the Main Floor, catching the red light before a single beat drops. Then the bassline cracks the silence open and Azúcar transforms into something feral, glittering, and a little bit haunted. This is Scream Queens, and the devil wears a wig.

Arrietty — RuPaul's Drag Race Season 17 — headlines a night built for chills and thrills, backed by a lineup of familiar faces who know how to work this stage: Santana, Slayonce, Puddlez, Cherry Pop, Anita Mormon, and more creatures of the night crawling out for one unforgettable show. Rohla Blunt and Miss Jaxon host and spin, keeping the energy razor-sharp between numbers that will leave you gasping, laughing, and reaching for your drink.

Expect smoke machines and sequins. Expect a lip-sync that stops your heart. Expect the kind of sexy that lingers after the lights come back up. Every corner of the room pulses — bodies pressed close, drinks sweating in the heat, the whole place humming like it's waiting for something to happen. It always does.

October 23rd, 9pm. Azúcar's Main Floor becomes a den of shadows and sequins for one night only — tickets are going fast, and this crowd doesn't wait around. Dress spooky, dress sexy, dress like you mean it. Come find out why they scream.

events.name: Burlesque Dance Workshop
events.description:
Shoulders back. Chin up. Hips ready to disobey orders. Frankie — Azúcar's lead burlesque gal — is taking over the Main Floor on October 25th to teach a choreographed routine with a sexy-soldier edge: sharp, disciplined moves that melt into pure seduction by the final count.

This isn't a watch-from-the-sidelines night. It's hands-on, step-by-step, build-the-routine-together energy — Frankie breaks it down move by move until the whole room is marching, snapping, and strutting in sync. No experience required, just a willingness to feel a little dangerous.

The vibe is playful but precise — think drill-sergeant confidence wrapped in burlesque glamour. Come solo and find your rhythm, come with friends and turn it into a dance floor squad. Donation-based entry means the only real cost is your inhibitions.

Show up ready to sweat, strut, and leave knowing exactly how to make an entrance.

events.name: Drag-O-Weeen
events.description:
The lounge gets haunted starting at 7PM — Drag-O-Ween is here and the mic is cursed in the best way. Grab your drag queen hostess, grab a song, and let the Main Floor turn into a glittering graveyard of bad decisions and great vocals.

Come in costume — the spookier, sexier, or more unhinged the better. Best dressed walks away with tickets to an upcoming drag show, so this isn't cute-costume energy, this is full-commitment energy. Vampires belting Whitney. Zombies murdering Mariah. It's all fair game.

The night doesn't have a bedtime — karaoke haunts the room from 7PM till whenever the last song drops, midnight or 2AM, nobody's counting. Drinks flowing, lipstick smudged, confidence at 110%.

Azúcar's Main Floor was made for nights like this — loud, a little chaotic, all heart. Pull your costume together and come sing like the devil's watching.

events.name: Rocky horror picture drag show
events.description:
Get your rice, your cards, your toast ready — Azúcar is turning the Main Floor into Frank-N-Furter's castle for one wild night. Cherry Pop hosts a full shadow cast drag production of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, lip-syncing, strutting, and sweating through every frame while the film plays behind them. This isn't a screening — it's a ritual, and you're in the cast.

The night opens right: before the film even rolls, each member of the cast steps up for their own solo number — a taste of the glitter and grit before the full chaos begins. Then it's lights down, projector up, and the shadow cast locks in beat for beat with the movie, prop bags on every table so you throw down at exactly the right moment. You'll know when.

Sing, shout the callbacks, dance the Time Warp in the aisles. The drag is sharp, the shadow cast is tighter, and the whole room turns into one glittering, corseted fever dream from the first frame to the last — interactive, unhinged, and exactly as messy as Rocky Horror should be.

Come in fishnets, come in a suit, come as Magenta, come as yourself — just come ready to lose your inhibitions with the rest of us. Specialty cocktails, a packed Main Floor, and Cherry Pop keeping the chaos gorgeous all night long. Antici...pation starts at 8pm on October 29. Don't be a virgin about it.

The second the credits roll, the real chaos begins. Ale rips off the host mic and slides into a mini drag show that turns scream into cheer. Wigs fly. Heels stomp. The season ends with glitter, not just gore.

Show up early — Lounge seats vanish fast, and nobody wants to miss episode one of the finale night everyone's buzzing about.

events.name: Link up
events.description:
Grab a seat, grab some beads — Link Up is Azúcar's craft night with heart. On November 1st starting at 6pm, the Main Floor trades its usual buzz for worktables full of charms, clasps, keychains, and carabiners, and everybody's invited to build something that's a little bit cute and a lot bit meaningful.

Jayme's hosting, and this one's co-presented with PFLAG because community doesn't just happen — you make it, link by link, charm by charm. Bring a small non-perishable snack to toss on the shared table, because the best crafting sessions run on chisme and chips. No experience needed, no pressure to make something perfect. Sit next to someone new, swap beads, swap stories.

This isn't about leaving with a perfect bracelet — though you will. It's about the hour you spent making it next to people who get it. Low lights, good music, hands busy, hearts a little fuller. Come solo, come with your crew, leave with a keychain and maybe a new friend or two.

Tables shuffle, strangers become teammates, drinks keep the trash talk flowing, and every round brings a fresh crew to flirt, bluff, and bond with. It's playful, it's a little competitive, and it's built for everybody who wants connection without the pressure of a dance floor.

Winners don't walk away empty-handed — small merch prizes drop throughout the night for whoever keeps surviving the Wild Draw Fours. Come for the cards, stay for the company, leave with new numbers in your phone and maybe a grudge against whoever hit you with Skip twice in one game.

events.name: Bachata class & social dance
events.description:
The neon's on, the floor's cleared, and Sholeh with Bachata Connection is ready to show you the way — paso a paso, no stress, no judgment. This is Bachata for the curious, the shy, the "I-have-two-left-feet" crowd, and the already-obsessed alike. Come alone, come con tu pareja, come as a bona fide Bachata All-Star — todos caben en esta pista.

Class kicks off at 8pm on the Main Floor under that glowing neon wash, breaking down the sensual sway and footwork that make Bachata Bachata — close enough to feel the rhythm, easy enough that nobody's left behind. Sholeh keeps it light, fun, and encouraging, so whether you're counting steps under your breath or already dipping your partner, you're exactly where you're supposed to be.

Then the real magic happens: class melts into social dancing, the lights stay low, the music stays hot, and the floor fills with bodies moving to that unmistakable Bachata pulse. No pressure, no perfect technique required — just vibe, sway, and the kind of connection that only happens on a dance floor.

Bring your energy, leave your nerves at the door. Azúcar's got the room, the ritmo, and the space — the rest is up to you.
